# Task
Task: ajcr-w5-av
Title: Wave 5: Pic^0 is an abelian variety — tangent kit, dim = g, smoothness
Project(s) — work across all of them:
- Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild at MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild
References: roadmap=AJCR.w5-av,AJCR.w5-av.t1,AJCR.w5-av.t3,AJCR.w5-av.t4,AJCR.w5-av.t5,AJCR.w5-av.s1,AJCR.w5-av.s2,AJCR.w5-av.s3; inbox=I-0492,I-0494,I-0495

CLOSE WAVE 5: Pic^0 is an abelian variety of dimension g. Roadmap AJCR.w5-av and its nine children. The interface layer is COMPLETE (JacobianData consumption interface, IsSeparated, translation transport, H1/genus base-field invariance, trunc-exp Cech kernel, the conditional AbelSourceData package) — so this task is the tangent-space mathematics, which is the largest block of work in the project that does NOT wait on the DD shape freeze.

THE CHAIN, in dependency order.

 (1) T1 — THE DUAL-NUMBER TANGENT KIT: pointed k[epsilon]-points, the cotangent dual, finrank reduction. Pure infrastructure, no gate, start here.

 (2) T3 — ker(relPic(k[epsilon]) -> relPic(k)) is additively isomorphic to H1(C, O_C).

 (3) T4 (WORKSHEET-FIRST, flagged risk R1) — the etale-plus / Zariski kernel crossing at k[epsilon]. This is the honest risk of the lane: the tangent computation is naturally Zariski but the functor is etale-plus. Write the worksheet before the Lean, and if the crossing does not go through, say so early and loudly rather than grinding — it changes the shape of T5.

 (4) T5 — THE SCALAR IDENTITY dim_k T_0(d.J) = g, under the scalar-identity-first discipline the roadmap names.

 (5) S1 (WORKSHEET-FIRST, risk R2) — geometric reducedness at the identity via the two-term H2 = 0 argument. S2 — Smooth d.J.hom via smooth_of_grpObj. S3 (WORKSHEET-FIRST, risk R3) — SmoothOfRelativeDimension g assembly, the frozen instance.

BLOCKED, AND NOT YOURS TO UNBLOCK: P1 (AbelSourceData discharge, proper Div^d-source) is a CROSS-WAVE GATE on the DD shapes freeze held by ajcr-divrep. Do not attempt it; do not build against a guessed shape. If the freeze lands during your run, take it then.

WORKSHEET-FIRST IS BINDING on T4, S1 and S3 — three of the four hardest items carry it explicitly because this lane has burned sessions on premature Lean before. The worksheet section is written or updated BEFORE the Lean, every time.

DISCIPLINE. Search before proving: horizon search spans this project, the AJC sibling, and mathlib. AJC has a Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean working the SAME tangent/H1 comparison from the other side (tangentSpaceCotangentDual, finrank_cotangentSpaceDual_eq_finrank_h1Cok) and an ajc-pic0av team is on it concurrently — read their work and talk to them; two independent derivations of dim T_0 = g is the exact waste the workspace exists to prevent. Use the LSP loop between edits.

CONCURRENCY IS BINDING. Four AJCR teams at once. Follow informal/protocol-concurrent-lanes.md exactly: private-index compare-and-swap ledger commits (never a bare git commit), and the mkdir lake mutex at /tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock (DIRECTORY lock; never flock it).

COORDINATION. Your files are the Wave-5 tangent/AV modules. Use the AJCR conversation thread for the DD freeze and the CROSS-PROJECT thread to compare notes with ajc-pic0av. Never edit files outside Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild.
